# Fredoka subset fixtures

These small TrueType subsets were served by Google Fonts on 2026-10-03 for
`family=Fredoka:wght@400`. They reproduce stale glyph coverage when a title introduces
uppercase letters and punctuation after an earlier request loaded only lowercase text.

- `Fredoka-Regular-small.ttf`: `text=its%20a%20croak`.
- `Fredoka-Regular-title.ttf`: `text=It%27s%20a%20Croak%21`.

Endpoint: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2`.
The returned font binaries identify Google Fonts version 17.
Copyright and SIL Open Font License: `Fredoka-OFL.txt`, from
`https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/fredoka/OFL.txt`.
